subject: Request: supplemental deployment control matrix & staging checklist
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@medsys.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: MedSys IT Security <infosec@medsys.com>
Date: 2027-12-01T09:13:00-08:00
Subject: Request: supplemental deployment control matrix & staging checklist

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed by Redwood's ability to serve private deployments. As part of our RFP review we need a more granular control matrix and a staging-environment checklist specifically for the on-prem / VPC air-gapped option.

Can you provide a short supplement that maps Redwood controls to our baseline requirements? In particular we need:
- Control mappings for key areas: KMS/HSM integration, network isolation, ingress/egress whitelisting, artifact provenance, and logging retention/replay.
- A staging checklist that your implementation team follows prior to sign-off (network changes, cert rotation, smoke tests, data egress tests).
- Any diagrams showing staging network segmentation and jump-host access patterns.

Deadline: we aim to consolidate technical responses by 2027-12-08. If you can get a deliverable to us by EOD 2027-12-07 that would be ideal.

Also include any evidence artifacts you can share (config snippets, CI/CD gating notes). If anything needs an NDA please flag that.

Best,
Alice Chen
Procurement Lead — MedSys Health
alice.chen@medsys.com

---

Alice — appreciate the clear list. We're assembling a short supplement that maps our controls to MedSys requirements and will include a staging checklist and a network diagram. I'm looping in Marcus (Solutions Architect) and Karthik (Infra) who will add the technical detail and evidence artifacts.

Plan:
- Today: Marcus/Karthik will prepare the control matrix (redwood_control_matrix_v2.xlsx) and a deployment checklist draft.
- Fri 2027-12-05: we will send the first packet (matrix + checklist + preliminary network diagram).
- Tue 2027-12-07 EOD: final packet including any config snippets and gating procedures.

We may need a short mutual NDA to share some infra screenshots and CI/CD gating logs; if so we'll send a DocuSign link.

Deliverables (preview): redwood_control_matrix_v2.xlsx (control mapping), deployment-staging-checklist.docx, staging-network-diagram.pdf (diagram showing segmentation and bastion flow).

Meeting: happy to book a 30-min call next week to walk the matrix. Do you have availability Monday or Tuesday?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: supplemental deployment control matrix & staging checklist

Hi Alice — attaching the first-pass materials and a short note on two items you called out.

Key clarifications (summary):
1) KMS/HSM: Redwood supports customer-managed keys via KMIP/KMS integrations. For on-prem air-gapped installs we provide key-wrapping patterns and documented HSM PIN lifecycle steps. The control matrix maps to NIST SP 800-57 and includes operational procedures for key rotation.

2) Network segmentation & jump-hosting: Our recommended staging topology uses a three-zone model: Management (bastion), Staging (application), and Artifact-only DMZ (for inbound software bundle validation). The attached staging-network-diagram.pdf shows NAT rules, allowed ports, and approved jump-host UX.

3) Evidence: the matrix links to sample smoke test commands and a CI gating checklist. Some artifacts contain implementation-specific logs; we can share sanitized snippets in this packet. For full raw logs we prefer an NDA.

Attachments included: redwood_control_matrix_v2.xlsx (completed sheet), staging-network-diagram.pdf, deployment-staging-checklist.docx (draft).

I'll add a short paragraph in the matrix about our audit log replay capability and retention options (configurable per-customer). If you need a formal attestation or SOC reference, we can include that in the next packet.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: staging-network-diagram.pdf (stub); deployment-staging-checklist.docx (stub)

Subject: Re: Request: supplemental deployment control matrix & staging checklist

Vanessa / Marcus — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. We reviewed the matrix and the network diagram; a few follow-ups before our procurement committee meets Friday: 

- Can you enumerate which artifacts require an NDA (exact file names or doc types)? You mentioned raw logs — can you confirm that sanitized samples are sufficient for the first pass?
- For the KMS/HSM section: is there an approved HSM vendor list or do you support generic KMIP-compatible devices? We need to know if Thales/Entrust are supported out of the box.
- The staging checklist looks good; please add a line item for a signed rollback test and a smoke-test SLA (who signs off and expected time window).

If you can update the packet with those items, we should be able to include Redwood in the final shortlist. Also, to share the NDA we've attached a DocuSign request here: https://www.docusign.com/12345-NDA-MEDSYS — please sign and we'll return countersigned copy.

Can we have the revised packet by EOD 2027-12-07? If not, please flag the earliest possible delivery time. Also propose a 30-minute call Monday 2027-12-10 10:00 AM PT to walk the final packet.

Thanks — Alice
Alice Chen
Procurement Lead — MedSys Health
alice.chen@medsys.com
